name: Four Seasons Dubai at Jumeirah Beach
insider_take: Dubai's oceanfront crown jewel where Arabian elegance meets contemporary luxury on the world's most famous man-made coastline.
whats_special: This stunning beachfront resort sits on the iconic Palm Jumeirah, the world's largest artificial island visible from space. The hotel features the city's only overwater spa treatment rooms and boasts unobstructed views of the Dubai Marina skyline. Its signature Mercury Lounge offers the unique experience of dining suspended over the Arabian Gulf.
pro_tip: Book a sunset dinner at the Mercury Lounge during winter months (November-March) for perfect weather and breathtaking views as the sun sets behind the Atlantis resort across the palm fronds.
dont_miss: The hotel's private 500-meter stretch of pristine white sand beach, complimentary access to the exclusive Nasimi Beach club, and the spectacular Burj Al Arab views from the infinity pools. The nearby Nakheel Mall offers world-class shopping just minutes away, while the monorail provides easy access to Atlantis and the mainland.
pros: Prime beachfront location on Jumeirah Beach with pristine white sand
Exceptional Four Seasons service with personalized attention
Luxurious spa and world-class dining options
Spacious rooms and suites with stunning ocean or city views
cons: Popular location can be busy during peak seasons
